bias.zh: 偏空 · 收复 200 日均线

read.en: Arm rose 2.5% on Oct 21 to $226.59, trading between $219.50 and $228.95, on light volume. It is above the rising 200-day ($225.1) but below the falling 5-day ($229.7), 10-day ($243.9), 30-day ($273.2) and 100-day ($292.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($264.79), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Arm 10月21日上涨 2.5%，收于 $226.59，盘中区间 $219.50–228.95，成交量偏低。股价位于上行的 200 日均线（$225.1）上方，但低于下行的 5 日（$229.7）、10 日（$243.9）、30 日（$273.2）和 100 日均线（$292.1）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$264.79），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200-day average and the $225.5–226.7 Sep 3–Oct 16 lows, which turn back into support; the low held $219.4. Resistance is $229–229.7 (Oct 21 high, 5-day), then $238 (Oct 14 close) and $244 (10-day). Support is $225–226.7, then $217.3–219.5 and $200.9 (May 12 low). A close above $229.7 would target $238; a close below $217 would open $201.
